answer_result.answer: Dave and Calvin share music-related activities: they planned to jam music together, and both are involved in music—Dave has a rock band and a music studio, while Calvin has a recording studio and performs/tours. They also share car-related activities: Dave restores/works on cars, and Calvin works on a car project and is into cars; Calvin also wanted to check out Dave's garage.

question.question: What shared activities do Dave and Calvin have?

- On 2023-10-08, caught up with Dave ("Hey Dave! What's up?"): Dave told him that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw awesome cars, got to mess with car mods, and there were so many cool machines around — "it was so much fun!" — and shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "Hey Dave, that sounds awesome! Dave: "Thanks! Yeah, this one looks great!" and said he restored and modified the car himself, adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades — it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" (shared a photo of a car driving down a street with a traffic light) [S22T3][S22T4]. Dave then said car restoration "is not just a hobby, it's a passion" — "like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress" — that as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage tinkering with engines ("it was like my own sanctuary"), and he's now "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." Dave: "Thanks, Calvin. It's been my goal since I was a kid and it's awesome to be able to do something I love. Restoring things like this can be tough but the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great. Absolutely, I'm loving it." (Dave's details in the Classic cars and Hobbies and sense of purpose sections of /memories/dave.md) [S22T5][S22T6][S22T7]. Calvin: "Go for it, Dave! Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." [S22T8].
- The 2023-10-08 conversation continued: Dave thanked Calvin — "Thanks, Calvin! Means a lot." — and said he's going to keep chasing his dreams and working hard, that conversations like this remind him why he loves what he does (Dave's side in the 2023-10-08 entry of the Relationships section of /memories/dave.md) [S22T9]; Calvin: "Glad I can remind you, Dave.
